subject: Green Score Zoning Ordinance
overview: The committee reviewed the proposed green score environmental zoning regulations and discussed public outreach strategies for the upcoming Salem Street corridor rezoning. The committee voted to refer the green score zoning ordinance to the regular City Council meeting.

items.title: Green Score Zoning Ordinance
items.summary: Paula Ramos Martinez presented the proposed environmental performance standards and landscape score menu, which the committee voted to refer to the regular City Council meeting following discussion of flood zone designations and construction bonds.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Update
items.summary: Consultants and staff presented a brief update on adapting mixed-use zoning for the Salem Street corridor, prompting council discussion regarding neighborhood meetings and public outreach methods.
